profile.summary:
Dynamic and detail-oriented Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record in designing, developing, and debugging web and backend solutions leveraging modern cloud technologies. Seeking a challenging role where I can leverage my expertise in full-stack development, cloud technologies, Agile methodologies, and mentorship to develop and operate complex, cloud-based systems cutting-edge software solutions. 

Be sure to check out my credentials and feel free to connect with me.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop enhancements and modifications to large mobile android device application, Oracle database, AngularJS website, Java Spring webservices. Conduct component testing of code changes to ensure code addresses the modification accurately and thoroughly. Create and update application designs for application enhancements.

company.name: Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
I joined the Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer (CIViC) project as a Lab Assistant during my freshman year, under the guidance of Dr. Malachi Griffith. My focus was on curating data related to von-Hippel Lindau disease (VHLD), which stems from VHL tumor suppressor gene inactivation. During my time I accomplished the following:
- Conducted comprehensive data analysis to identify trends and insights, presenting findings to the lab & research conferences.
- Conducted literature reviews and synthesized information to support research objectives.
- Contributed to the preparation of research reports and presentations for publication and conferences.
- Developed and maintained databases to organize research data and facilitate data retrieval and analysis.
- Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving abilities by effectively interpreting complex data sets.
- Excels in communication and collaboration, consistently contributing to team success.
- Manages and analyzes data with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and reliability in results.

My contribution helps advance the CIViC project's aim of creating a robust online repository for VHL variants.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted in bioinformatics research projects focused on von-Hippel Lindau (VHL) disease, performing data analysis and interpretation.
- Utilized bioinformatics tools and software to analyze genomic data and identify genetic variations.
- Contributed to the development and implementation of algorithms for sequence analysis and data mining.
- Collaborated with research team members to generate reports and present findings at conferences.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I attended the Quantitative Biology SURP program at Princeton and worked in the Department of Computer Science under the mentorship of Dr. Ben Raphael and grad student Gryte Satas. My project for the summer was to build a probabilistic model -- hidden Markov model -- to help identify large deletions/duplications in chromosomal DNA. I generated data to train and test the model using Python and Bash scripts. Feel free to click the link to look at some of the projects in the lab. Very interesting.
